text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Narita 
Brian...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Guess not.
choice_data_list: Have you been holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. No problem. Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian remained restless like that 
all the way back to the academy. I should 
probably ask her properly what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... You're persistent, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I dropped my wallet. That's all there is 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's just the one I was using for spare 
change anyway, so there's nothing 
important in it. It doesn't really matter.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What's this all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: Giving up will become a habit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, making it sound so plausible...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't given up on it. I was planning 
to go search for it later."
choice_data_list:
It'll be more efficient if the two of us 
search together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... This is why I hate letting you 
find out about things. It always turns 
into such a hassle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who lost it. I'll search for 
it. So, just go home.
choice_data_list:
It's okay, I'm sure we'll find it right 
away!
When I'm in trouble, I'll ask for help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Where does this optimism of yours even 
come from...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. You must have a plan if 
you're so adamant about it, right? Where 
should we start looking?"
choice_data_list: Let's head back the way we came!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is far too inefficient...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
However, if I don't head back, I won't be 
able to find it, will I...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Got it. Might as well go and see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I retraced my steps and arrived in 
front of the station—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Right, now that I think about it, I 
took out my wallet when buying the 
ticket...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wait here for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My wallet was turned in at the station. 
Apparently, I left it right next to the 
ticket machine...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That was a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the wallet safely recovered, I headed 
back home with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just who are you gonna get to help? Are 
you gonna go around asking random 
passersby?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, shall we do that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I won't, and it's not okay. Are you stupid 
or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"In a situation like this, we should 
probably ask the police box or the staff 
here."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, wait...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the station and asking 
if a lost wallet had been turned in—

text_block_list.name: Station Attendant
text_block_list.text:
A coin purse... Ah, yes, it's been turned 
in. They said it was found near the ticket 
machines.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the coin purse was safely found 
and returned to Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're finding quite a lot, 
surprisingly.
choice_data_list: It's because you didn't give up
It's all because you didn't give up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, don't get cocky. It's only thanks to 
some stranger picking it up for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was certainly one factor that 
helped us find it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's enough, it's getting late. Let's 
head home, quick...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the wallet safely found, I headed 
back home with Narita Brian.
